digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler inbound link removal and graph layer dependency management
propositions: Inbound link removal for a pair holding two differently-related dependencies (e.g., blocks and relates_to) never converges due to key asymmetry: writes are relation-scoped but removal is pair-scoped
Guard G5 in _inbound_unlink_one declines to remove a link when the named relation does not match the pair's most-recent net-active relation, causing re-emission and permanent decline on every pass
Relation-scoped removal seam must be added to graph/_links.py symmetric with add_dependency, keyed on (target_id, relation) instead of pair-scoped removal
CLI and library facade (rebar.unlink) must gain optional relation argument while preserving backward compatibility: with no relation uses existing pair-scoped behavior

When named relation has no matching net-active local link, removal must be a logged no-op and never remove any other relation's link, preserving the safety invariant that no peer-carried link is destroyed
